agency.title: Scheduling Settings
agency.subtitle: Define the available periods for visits and the granularity of agent time slots.
agency.savedDesc: The scheduling settings have been updated.
agency.periodsSubtitle: Clients choose a period, not an exact time.
agency.weekdaysSubtitle: Days of the week when visits can be scheduled.
agency.capacitySubtitle: Adjust proposal limits, internal interval and capacity per time slot.
agency.maxChoicesSubtitle: How many periods the client can suggest (1-5).
agency.intervalSubtitle: Granularity of sub-slots visible to the agent within each period.
agency.maxVisitsSubtitle: Limit of confirmed visits at the same time (HH:MM) for the property.

scoring.title: Candidate Scoring
scoring.subtitle: Define the importance of each factor in candidate evaluation.
scoring.presetHint: Selecting a profile applies the suggested levels — you can adjust individually afterwards.
scoring.legendCritical: — low score here = almost certain rejection
scoring.classificationSubtitle: At what final score a candidate is Excellent or Potential.
scoring.numericSubtitle: Define the values at which income-to-rent ratio and commitments are considered ideal, good, weak or low.
scoring.incomeRatioNote: Bands: <{{ir0}}× → below minimum · ≥{{ir0}}× → minimum · ≥{{ir1}}× → weak · ≥{{ir2}}× → good · ≥{{ir3}}× → ideal
scoring.commitmentsNote: Bands: <{{cp0}}% → low · {{cp0}}–{{cp1}}% → medium · {{cp1}}–{{cp2}}% → high · ≥{{cp2}}% → very high
